notes: Nine of the page's 10 styles are encoded: page styles 2, 7 and 10 from the page text (file styles 1-3) and page styles 3, 4, 5, 6, 8 and 9 from the page's charts, verified in the image pass Nov 8 (file styles 4-9). Page style 1 carries no serial encoding (year and month read only from the printed manufacture-date label) and is not encoded. Related brands Goodman, Amana and Janitrol are listed on the page but use their own serial systems; no styles are copied from them and usesStylesOf is null. Two-digit years resolve by the schema century rule with floor 1960. Example decodes are derived mechanically from the page's documented positions (the page states positions, not manufactured-in sentences, for these three styles).

styles.era: Page style 2: 4-letter prefix followed by 10 digits
styles.notes: Page style 2: year is the 5th and 6th characters (first two digits after the 4-letter prefix), month is the 7th and 8th characters. Example decode derived from the documented positions: 09 -> 2009, 05 -> May.

styles.era: Page style 7: 1 letter followed by 9 digits
styles.notes: Page style 7: year is the 2nd and 3rd digits, week is the 4th and 5th digits. Example decode derived from the documented positions: 88 -> 1988, week 12.
Page style 10: year is the 1st and 2nd numbers, month is the 3rd and 4th numbers. Example decode derived from the documented positions: 16 -> 2016, 02 -> February.

styles.era: Page style 3: Daikin-McQuay ductless split system units, 14-digit numeric serials
styles.notes: Chart-verified (image-pass Nov 8): year is the first four digits, week the next two. The chart prints only five year rows (2043-2047); the '*'/'Etc.' arrow is not extrapolated to 2048-2005. Daikin-McQuay ductless split system units.

styles.era: Page style 4: Daikin-McQuay incremental and heat pump units (Auburn), 9-digit numeric serials
styles.notes: Chart-verified (image-pass Nov 8): year is the 3rd digit, week the 4th-5th digits. The chart prints only four year rows with '*'/'Etc.' arrows both ways; only the four printed rows are encoded.

styles.era: Page style 5: 10-character serials, year digit + month letter
styles.notes: Chart-verified (image-pass Nov 8): year is the 1st digit, month is the 3rd character. The page text says the 3rd character gives the week; the chart labels it Month with a JAN-DEC table, so the chart governs and the page text is in error on this point.

styles.era: Page style 6: 10-character serials, digit + two letters + 7 digits
styles.notes: Chart-verified (image-pass Nov 8): year is the 2nd character, month is the 3rd character. Year letters skip I and O; month letters skip I.

styles.era: Page style 8: Daikin-McQuay condensing units prior to 1988, 17-character serials
styles.notes: Chart-verified (image-pass Nov 8): year is the 11th character, week the 12th-13th. The image serial has a 10-digit prefix, which is self-consistent with the stated 11th-character position; the page-text list's 12-digit variant contradicts its own position and is not used. The tip says 'prior to 1988' yet the table includes R=1988; transcribed as printed.

styles.era: Page style 9: 8-character serials, two letters + 6 digits
styles.notes: Chart-verified (image-pass Nov 8): year is the 1st letter, month is the 2nd letter. No continuation marker on the chart, so codes outside T-Z return cannot-determine; no extrapolation.
